en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes down 31 points at 24314
en.dek: The benchmark ended Wednesday's session at 24,314.17, a fall of 0.13 per cent from the previous close, after trading between 24,115 and 24,524.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed at 24,314.17 on Wednesday, down 31.05 points or 0.13 per cent from the previous close of 24,345.22, according to data from the Hang Seng Indexes Company.
The index traded between a session low of 24,115 and a high of 24,524.63 during the day. Turnover details were not immediately available in the closing summary.

Financial and property sub-indices finished lower, while the commerce and industry classification recorded a modest gain. Market participants had been watching overseas leads and local developments earlier in the session.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收市報24314點 跌31點
zh.dek: 基準指數周三收報24314.17點，較前收市跌0.13%，全日高低位介乎24115至24524。
body: 恒生指數公司資料顯示，恒生指數周三收市報24314.17點，較前一交易日收市的24345.22點下跌31.05點，或0.13%。
指數全日低位24115點，高位24524.63點。收市摘要暫未詳列成交額數字。
金融及地產分類指數收市下跌，工商業分類則錄得輕微升幅。早段市場曾受外圍走勢及本地消息影響而波動。
